data.name: Chud Crusade
data.detailed_description:
CHUD CRUSADE is here to save you.

CHUD CRUSADE is a third-person RPG where you can choose a human warrior, a zombie, a robot, a vampire, or an alien. Each will have its own abilities but also their own flaws. There will be a trade-off to each. Zombies won't have any health for instance so one shot to the head or decapitation will kill them. Robots are nigh on indestructible but can be EMP'd easily to deactivate them.

Players will progress through 5 unique biomes therefore which are the homes for each of the characters, taking on quests, killing baddies, levelling up, and acquiring new gear to strengthen their abilities and mitigate their flaws.

The soundtrack for the game is drum & bass - heartpounding electronic music to motivate you to spur on and inspire you during cinematic moments.

Right now it's terrible because I've only just started making it - but the mechanics are going in and they're taken directly from your favorite games.

So join me on this journey to Make Games Great Again!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor or higher
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 16Gb
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
